nodes.description: Public string array of IPFS hashes used as phase artwork URIs
mapping(uint256 => uint256) recording block.timestamp when a token was claimed
mapping(uint256 => bool) flag marking a token as rare, set from blockhash-based pseudo randomness
Counters.Counter private used as the ERC721 token id supply counter
address payable constant receiving the claimed ETH via low-level call
Public claim price in wei, increased by 3% on every claim
Payable public entrypoint: takes ETH, forwards it to buidlguidl, raises price, mints a token and records birth/rare
View override returning a phase-based URI derived from token age and rarity
Deploys ERC721('ButterflyClaims','BTFLYC') and sets the IPFS base URI
Caller-controlled address used as receiver of the minted token in claim()
Miner-influenced timestamp used for birth recording and token age computation
Low-level external call buidlguidl.call{value: msg.value}('') executed before minting, enabling reentrancy
Arithmetic state update price = (price * 103) / 100 executed on each claim
Pseudo-randomness via blockhash(block.number-1) used to decide the rare flag, gameable by miners
Local bool returned by the low-level ETH call in claim()
Local token id read from _tokenIds.current() in claim()
Parameter of tokenURI used to look up birth and rarity
Local string holding the selected phase hash in tokenURI()
Local uint256 age = block.timestamp - birth[tokenId] in tokenURI()
Local string holding baseURI() in tokenURI()

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside claim(), so caller identity flows into the function
claim() executes the external call to buidlguidl with msg.value before minting and recording state
buidlguidl is an arbitrary payable address; its fallback can re-enter claim() while state is not yet updated
The current price state variable is read to compute the new price
price = (price * 103) / 100 writes the arithmetic result back into the price state variable
claim() triggers the price arithmetic update on every invocation
block.timestamp is written into birth[id], making token birth depend on miner-controlled time
tokenURI() computes age from block.timestamp, so URI selection is timestamp dependent
birth[tokenId] is read to derive age, coupling the returned URI to the recorded timestamp
tokenURI() selects an entry from the phases state array as the artwork hash
tokenURI() reads the rare mapping to choose between phase 4 and phase 5
claim() may write rare[id] = true based on the blockhash-derived value
claim() invokes the blockhash-based pseudo-random rarity computation
The blockhash-derived value determines whether the rare flag is set
claim() increments the _tokenIds counter before minting
claim() assigns _tokenIds.current() to the local id
The local id is used as mint argument and returned by claim()
The tokenId parameter indexes birth and rare inside tokenURI()
tokenURI() assigns the selected phase hash to the local _tokenURI
tokenURI() stores block.timestamp - birth[tokenId] into the local age
tokenURI() stores baseURI() into the local base
The success flag of the external call is captured in the local sent inside claim()

normalization_plan.reason: The boolean sent is only the success flag of the unsafe low-level call in claim() and carries no independent semantics
The local id is a transient token identifier produced and returned entirely within claim()
The tokenId parameter is used exclusively to index state inside tokenURI()
The local _tokenURI is a temporary holder for the phase hash computed inside tokenURI()
The local age is a derived intermediate value of the timestamp-based URI selection in tokenURI()
The local base only caches baseURI() for the concatenation performed inside tokenURI()
